report_name: Check Point Patches Critical CVSS 9.8 VPN Flaws

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-85102
vulnerabilities.description: An improper certificate trust validation vulnerability in Check Point VPN products that could allow a remote, unauthenticated attacker to bypass authentication mechanisms. It affects Security Gateways and Spark Firewalls configured with Site-to-Site or Remote Access VPN.

vulnerabilities.name: CVE-2026-85103
vulnerabilities.description: A heap-based buffer overflow vulnerability in the ASN.1 decoding of VPN certificates. A remote, unauthenticated attacker could send a specially crafted certificate to cause a crash or achieve arbitrary code execution. It affects Security Gateways, Spark Firewalls, and the Security Management Server.
